summary: community.general keycloak_clientscope_rolemappings, clientscope_type, clientsecret_*, clienttemplate, component and component_info are now redirects requiring middleware_automation.keycloak.

answer_card.title: Keycloak redirects in community.general (part 3)
answer_card.answer_md:
These community.general modules are now **redirects** to `middleware_automation.keycloak`. The redirect only works if you **install `middleware_automation.keycloak`**:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install middleware_automation.keycloak
```

Affected modules (each maps to `middleware_automation.keycloak.<name>`):

`keycloak_clientscope_rolemappings` (→ `keycloak_client_scope_rolemappings`), `keycloak_clientscope_type` (→ `keycloak_client_scope_type`), `keycloak_clientsecret_info`, `keycloak_clientsecret_regenerate`, `keycloak_clienttemplate`, `keycloak_component`, `keycloak_component_info`
